Three pillars, one engine

Pinpoint is purpose-built for Laravel teams that care about latency, not dashboards.

Dual-Signal N+1 Detection

Combines Eloquent's native handleLazyLoadingViolationUsing hook (model + relation name certainty) with CRC32 SQL parameter placeholder collapse as a fallback for raw query builders.

App\Models\Order → items

Sub-Millisecond Overhead (< 0.29ms)

Heavy stack traces (debug_backtrace) run strictly in local environments with depth caps (DEBUG_BACKTRACE_IGNORE_ARGS). Database writes are deferred to Laravel's terminating event, off the request cycle.

standard 1420ms → pinpoint 1420.29ms

Local-First IDE Continuity

Built for terminal and VS Code. Local API endpoints (/_pinpoint/api/v1) let your IDE read percentile rollups instantly without waiting on an hourly cron.

CMD + Click → Jump to Line

Quickstart

Three commands from zero to actionable latency insight.

01

Install as a dev dependency

composer require asimali/pinpoint --dev
02

Publish & run migrations

php artisan vendor:publish --tag="pinpoint-migrations" && php artisan migrate
03

Generate your first latency report

php artisan pinpoint:report

Measured overhead on a typical route

Deferred flush keeps your users off the critical path.
